Hi Marissa / team,

Thanks again for the call earlier — appreciated the overview of Redwood's dedicated offering. A few items the security team asked me to capture so we can start our vendor review:

- Current SOC 2 status (in-scope/Type II vs Type I) and expected timeline for a Type II report if not yet available.
- HIPAA posture and whether Redwood will sign a BAA.
- Evidence for Identity & Access Management: SSO/SAML metadata, SCIM provisioning support, role-based access controls (admin roles), and audit log retention/format.

We've kicked off a questionnaire in our vendor portal but wanted to get the basics in parallel. Can you share a single packet (or links) with the IAM artifacts you typically provide to prospects? If you have a checklist that's perfect.

Target timeline from our side: security would like initial artifacts by EOD Monday so we can triage before the procurement meeting on Wednesday. Is that doable?

Thanks,

Vastly Health

Hi Samantha — great speaking with you earlier. Appreciate the clear list. Summary and next steps below so your security and procurement teams have the context in one thread.

Quick recap:
- Redwood supports SSO (SAML 2.0) and SCIM provisioning for user lifecycle. We also provide RBAC with configurable admin/engineer/support roles and can restrict access by org units for Dedicated/Private customers.
- SOC 2: Redwood is currently SOC 2 Type I (report available) and we have an internal roadmap to complete Type II by Q4 2026. I'll include the Type I report and SOC 2 roadmap.
- HIPAA: Redwood supports HIPAA-regulated workloads under our Private offering; we execute BAAs for customers with covered data.

Requested artifacts we'll provide in a single packet:
1) Redwood IAM evidence checklist (what we typically share) — attached.
2) SAML metadata (XML) — will share the IdP/SP metadata file.
3) SCIM capabilities doc and sample provisioning payloads.
4) RBAC role matrix (CSV) showing default roles and admin privileges.
5) Audit log sample (redacted) and retention policy.
6) SOC 2 Type I report + SOC 2 timeline/plan.

Action items / timing:
- I have looped in Aditya (security/technical liaison) and Monica (customer operations) to collect the artifacts.
- Target: deliver initial packet by Monday EOD (2026-08-24). If we need anything on your side (e.g., SP ACS URL, entityID, provisioning attribute map), I'll follow up.

If it helps, here's a short checklist of items we might ask you to provide: SP ACS URL, SP entityID, preferred NameID (email/uid), SCIM base URL + token provisioning preferences, and a point of contact for the procurement/infosec review.

Let me know if the timeline works.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
